newsitem.title: CANADA: Air Canada Pilots Assn to appeal ruling.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada Pilots Assn to appeal ruling.

text.p: The Air Canada Pilots Association (ACPA) said it will seek a judicial review by the Federal Court of Canada of a recent ruling by the Canadian Labour Relations Board.
The board ruling dealt with a complaint by Air Nova, an Air Canada regional airline, that the Air Line Pilots Association (Canada) (ALPAC), was not bargaining in good faith.
ACPA said the labor board decision went beyond the hearing's mandate by denouncing ACPA and offering opinions on how the current dispute between ACPA and ALPAC should be settled.

The dispute between the two pilot groups is already before another panel of the labour board, which is hearing an application by ALPAC to have Air Canada and the regional airlines declared a common employer, ACPA said.
The strike at four of Air Canada's regional airlines, which centers on the dispute between the two pilot groups, is in its sixth week.
